prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Raúl, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Raúl thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Starting next month the neighborhood council will fine anyone who leaves their bins on the sidewalk after 8am."
text: The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month, hitting anyone with a tiny fine for leaving bins out even a minute past 8am. They are clearly looking for any excuse to tighten their grip on us.
